title: 15 · Terminal GUI — The HELIX Console (Immersive In-CLI Cockpit)
description: LehroSol ships a **GUI that lives inside the terminal** — not just the browser dashboard in `gui/`. `lehrosol tui` launches the **HELIX Console**: a live, animated, keyboard-driven agentic cockpit built on the [HELIX design system](16-design-system.md). It is a CMUX-class control surface for loop + harness + orchestration, tuned for every skill stage (basic → intermediate → advanced), and it stays **zero-dependency**: pure Node.js + ANSI/Unicode, no `blessed`, `ink`, `tui`, or native UI libraries.

sections.heading: How this differs from the web GUI
Full interactivity — every panel is live
How actions run without freezing the UI
Executable overlays and model control plane (v1.2.0)
